title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African stew made with tender lamb, aromatic spices, and a rich broth.

ingredients.name: Tunisian lamb tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add spice blend, salt, and water. Bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to the oven. Braise at 300°F for 2 hours.
Remove from oven and let rest for 15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Serve with crusty bread or over couscous, if desired.
